hypotheses.L1_fisher_predicts_local_kl_direction: At 10% dose, predicted versus exact per-site KL correlation is at least 0.90 for every variant and corpus.
hypotheses.L2_fisher_locally_calibrated: At 10% dose, median exact/predicted KL is between 0.5 and 2.0 for every variant and corpus.
hypotheses.L3_fisher_predicts_full_replacement: At 100% dose, predicted versus exact per-site KL correlation is at least 0.80 for every variant and corpus.
hypotheses.L4_fisher_rank4_beats_frobenius_locally: At 10% dose, Fisher-selected rank four has lower mean exact KL than Frobenius rank four on every corpus.
hypotheses.L5_local_kl_is_quadratic: For every variant and corpus, mean exact KL divided by dose squared changes by at most a factor of two between 10% and 25% dose.
